editorial_decision: No accession added to Dongria inventory. Regional catalogue preserved for comparison, not relabelled as community evidence.
next_action: Pause broad seed searches. Reopen on an accessible village-linked passport or dated custodian inventory; move the next series pass to a different reporting priority.
